fields.title: Plan Game Days
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Pick three scenarios for the first game days and explain the order.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Available: disable recommendations, payment provider outage, database restore from backup, zone switch, search outage, communication procedure check.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: start with optional and reversible — recommendations, search. Then communication: cheap, breaks nothing, almost always finds issues. Then payment provider during off-peak hours. Database restore and zone switch are later, they are the riskiest and require preparation. Technique: order by increasing risk, not by importance.
